attachment_projection: attachments remain retained only in original private capture; public-source path values are labels and no attachment payload is included in this projection
campaign_invalidation: explicit projection exceptions may change only named campaign-disposition fields; original producer values and immutable original hashes remain in source-bindings.json
duplicate_json_keys: checked for every emitted JSON and JSONL record by this exporter
endpoint_projection: base_url is always the synthetic placeholder http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1; it is not an observed or routable service endpoint
numeric_field_integrity: every source JSON numeric leaf is compared before write; redaction may replace text only
request_journal_rebinding: capacity request_journal remains an object; only its path, sha256, and bytes are intentionally rebound to the redacted sibling journal projection
unsafe_text_scan: checked for private path roots, host identity, GPU UUIDs, and secret-like markers by this exporter

viewer.command: python -m anvil_serving.cli eval benchmark evidence show ARTIFACT --json
viewer.supported_schema: anvil-serving.benchmark/v1 capacity artifacts; validate each emitted capacity file after export
viewer.unsupported_reason: the installed evidence-show command reports these native schemas as unrecognized; they are retained without flattening
unsupported_schemas: native-MTP paired engine accounting (no declared benchmark schema)
